Stevedores’ Union, came into existence on November 29, 
1936 when an inaugural meeting was held in the Yoeh

Subject A. Sing Company, Stevedoring Contractors at 209 Broadway - Attack

Made by J.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. Crawford S.I.

In connection with the recent attack on the foreman
superintendent of the A. Sing Company, 209 Broadway, by a
number of ex-casual labourers (Vice Crime No. 114/47 of
Hongkew Station), it appears that an ex-foreman named Hsu
(徐維□) has been agitating for his reinstatement, and in addition
has been endeavouring to induce other ex-employees to take
part in a strike or disturbance at the above address. This
matter has been reported to the Labour Section who are dealing
with it.

On April 13th there was trouble on the S/S

Since that time there does not appear to
have been any activity on the part of the so-called Union
and we are wondering if a Stevedore Union actually exists.

We are naturally following up very closely
any organized labor matters and would like to secure
authentic information on the subject. We would therefore
greatly appreciate your kindness if you could let us know
what was at the back of the occurrence on the S/S CATHAY,
and any other information that you may have in respect to

日期 1937年4月16日。
事由 关于日本海军号手通过中央区一事。
由 布朗里格（Brownrigg）督察呈报 经由 C 毕晓普（C Bishop）转呈

先生，
1937年4月16日上午9点50分，六十五名日本海军号手、两名军官以及携带信鸽的骑自行车者，吹着军号，经由外白渡桥进入中央区。该分队在外滩公园休整十五分钟，最终于上午10点10分再次出发，经外滩和南京路前往兆丰公园（Jessfield）方向。中央巡捕房派出的一支护卫队在外白渡桥与该部队会合，并护送他们至山西路与南京路转角处。在该分队离开外滩公园时，立即通过电话通知了老闸巡捕房（Louza Station）。

督察

分区助理处长（政治部）
“A”分区警官
归档
5月8日/
